items.text: Pinned Sidebar navigation with your libraries and an All Libraries view, now the default on Apple TV
Scrolling title marquee under cards for longer names

items: Remove titles directly from Continue Watching
Release history in Settings, with a What's New card after updates

items.text: New default focus state for cards

items: Continue Watching keeps more titles and retires stale next-episode suggestions

items.text: iPhone Home and detail hero artwork fades
Home hero descriptions changing after swiping to a title

items: Watchlist ordering and sync bugs
Missing progress bars at the start of playback
Detail pages now show different artwork from the Home hero
Hero logos are now the same size on Home and the detail page
Show pages no longer open with a blank hero
Continue Watching now shows time remaining on titles whose runtime was missing
Release dates on movie and show pages
Option to hide ratings until you've finished watching
Continue Watching card shape, spacing and logo legibility
Home artwork now appears instantly at launch and refreshes in the background
Network shares: shows whose episodes sit in season folders were missing from the TV Shows and Anime libraries
Network shares: a show held on both a server and a share showed up twice in Continue Watching, with the second card missing its progress bar and episode number
Recently Added no longer blurs show posters that gave nothing away (real episode thumbnails are still blurred)
Air dates showing a day early on Jellyfin outside the Americas
Continue Watching artwork styles
Autoplay next episode setting
Watchlist performance
Language picker now uses a native menu
Playback engine update, including HDR and Dolby Vision playback
Blurred Continue Watching row when spoiler protection is on
Plex watchlist removal
Invisible buttons on dark themes
Home hero now shows ratings, description, and air schedule for shows
Hero artwork blends into the page more smoothly and matches across Apple TV and iPhone/iPad
Hero text is easier to read
Play from the Home hero now works when the hero is showing a TV show
Home no longer goes blank when every server or library is switched off
Deleting a profile no longer blanks the screen
Any profile can now be deleted, not just some
PIN entry now fits properly when unlocking a profile
Plex now recovers on its own after a server drops out
Faster app launch
Turning a server off now removes its watchlist titles again
Removed titles stay removed, even if a server still lists them
Plex watchlists: the full list now loads, not just the first page
Titles you own are now recognised instead of prompting you to request them
Anime no longer shows up twice
Switching Plex user now updates Home and the watchlist right away

Watchlist is now a single list that follows you across Apple TV, iPhone, and iPad, and syncs to connected trackers (Simkl, AniList, MyAnimeList, Plex, and Jellyfin); anime is matched via AniDB/MAL/AniList ids

items.text: 'New episode every Friday' now appears on Home on iPhone and iPad, matching the Apple TV

items: Tracker sign-ins now sync across devices, so connecting a tracker like Simkl on one device no longer signs you out on others

items.text: iPhone/iPad: the trailer button now sits next to Play and is the last action to fold away

items: Saving a show from an episode page or from Continue Watching now saves the show, not the episode
Watchlisted titles on a server you cannot currently reach now show their poster instead of a blank card

items.text: Home no longer keeps a CPU core busy while idle; battery use is now well under 1%

items: The Home hero trailer now stops when you leave Home or the app, instead of continuing to play in the background

items.text: iPhone/iPad: the watchlist button is back on hero pages that front an episode
iPhone/iPad: heroes no longer drift sideways on titles with a wide logo
iPhone/iPad: the paging dots (including the progress bar inside them) now animate smoothly

items: Detail pages for titles outside your library now show richer details: release and streaming availability, trailers, cast, ratings, related titles, and request status
New poster marks distinguish titles not in your library from titles you can request
Playback now remembers which version of a show you picked and reuses it everywhere, including the next episode, and prefers the closest server when a title is on more than one

items.text: iOS: Downloads is now its own tab

tvOS player controls redesigned: title and Subtitles/Audio/Speed buttons now sit on one line above the scrub bar, with Info as a tab below it (press Up from the scrub bar for the buttons, Down for the Info card)

items: Series pages now load a whole season at once and scroll more smoothly

items.text: iOS: Search moved to the system search slot

items: Playback engine updated to AetherEngine 6.0.2

items.text: tvOS: Back no longer quits the app when a context menu is closing

items: Series detail: the hero-to-episodes transition has been rebuilt for smoother, more fluid focus movement
The first season chip and the focused Play button are no longer clipped on their left edge
The episode rail's loading label is now translated

Related — a new rail above the cast on every movie and series page, listing other titles in your library connected to what you're viewing; anime pages lead with actual sequels and side stories, and everything listed is something you own and can play
Media shares now show cast information for their titles

items.text: iPhone and iPad gained air-schedule badges, upcoming episodes in the rail, and the new Related row, matching the Apple TV

items: When the same title exists on both a media server and a file share, the server's copy now fronts the card since it carries the curated record; playback still prefers whichever copy is closest
Play/Resume buttons now name the episode they'll play (e.g. "Play S21, E8", or a resume bar showing "S5, E12 - 43m")
Player controls: the control bar now auto-hides when idle (stays up while a menu is open)
New Home Performance Overlay toggle under Help & Diagnostics in Settings
Added NFO / local sidecar metadata support
Home hero: smoother page-to-page animation, tidier spacing, and a lighter left-edge scrim
Home hero logos now fade in instead of popping
Dolby Vision / direct-file HDR now carries correctly across back-to-back episodes, with display sync fixed
Seeking during load no longer snaps back to the start (notably Dolby Vision over SMB)
Cleaner playback startup: the spinner now holds until the picture is really on screen, loading messages are paced better, and network files start faster
Fixed an end-of-file glitch when seeking near the end of a network file
Media shares now show scan and artwork progress on Home and in Settings
Movies and shows from media shares now resume where you left off and support subtitle files stored alongside the video
Dolby Atmos badges now stay accurate after background checks and source changes
Switching between copies on different servers now works more reliably without leaving the detail page
Posters, descriptions, and logos now choose the best available information more reliably across your servers
Signing in to or updating a media share now recovers more reliably if saving is interrupted
Full Emby support, including movies, TV, music, subtitles, skip intro, and HDR/Dolby Vision playback
Smoother Home Hero paging and tab switching
Fixed episode ordering
Fixed HDR/Dolby badges
Fixed clipped ratings
Redesigned media-share setup for SMB, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP/FTPS, and NFS, including automatic protocol detection and folder browsing
Improved local-library matching, metadata, duplicate handling, watch progress, and resume behavior across servers and file shares
Playback now recovers after leaving Plozz and returning, with video, controls, and progress resuming correctly
Season requests: search a partly owned show, open Request More, and request one season or all missing seasons (with per-profile Seerr users and pending/processing/failed/retry/completed states)
Per-profile server/library toggles in Appearance and Profiles

Series browsing: opening long-running shows from series, season, or episode cards now shows the current season immediately, without an extra scroll, and keeps episode/season navigation centered and stable
Redesigned animated onboarding setup flow for Plex and Jellyfin, including Plex QR/manual sign-in, Jellyfin Quick Connect, Back navigation, focus movement, and library selection
SMB and local shares: improved scanning of mixed movie/TV folders, version grouping, season deduplication, watch state, sidecar subtitles, search, sorting, and browsing responsiveness
Playback: improved Dolby Vision/HDR playback and episode handoffs, Up Next, subtitle search/download/hot-load, and a redesigned Playback Info display
Detail-page Cast now remains a consistent size at every display density
New Watched Indicator setting in Appearance — choose between a watched checkmark or an unwatched blue corner flag
Edit Profile now has emoji avatars, a new color grid, auto-save, and a delete button
SMB media shares now scan into Recently Added, Search, and Movies/TV/Anime rows with posters and artwork
Seerr requests can now be made as a specific user via per-user mapping
Redesigned Settings: Customize Home (shared rows plus a toggle for per-library rows), simpler library on/off, Spoilers moved to Appearance, and Integrations renamed to Trackers
In-progress items no longer show as watched
Blank movie/TV posters now fill in
Hero images no longer blur
Detail pages no longer jump when moving across the top buttons
Customizable Home hero
Seerr integration — request media from the hero or search, with the button reflecting download status
Choose whether to merge your home page across servers
Select which rows appear on Home
Reorganized Settings (still a work in progress)
Tentative SMB support
New navigation paradigm, with an option in Settings to switch back to top tabs
Limited SMB share support (expect breakage)
New navigation toggle in Settings
Default navigation is now side navigation
AirPlay now works more consistently with music
Add both a Jellyfin and a Plex server and combine them into one multi-server library
Browse Movies, TV, and Music
Playback with resume and automatic skip of intros/credits
Themes, display-size settings, and night mode
